title: 全球人形机器人出货：中国拿下97%，灵巧手才是下一关？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: From the caress to the cut, from playing to pick things.
segments.zh: 从轻抚到切割，从玩耍到拾取。

segments.en: There isn't a lot the human hand can't do.
segments.zh: 人类双手几乎无所不能。

segments.en: And replicating it is the biggest challenge facing robotics.
segments.zh: 复制它，是机器人技术面临的最大挑战。

segments.en: It's one thing to have humanoids that can run a road race, jump a high jump or break dance.
segments.zh: 人形机器人能跑长跑、跳高或跳街舞是一回事。

segments.en: It's quite another. Do you have a humanoid with a sophisticated, dexterous hand?
segments.zh: 但拥有精密灵巧的手，则完全是另一回事。

segments.en: China wants to build a more advanced manufacturing capability and robotic hands are actually a big part of that project.
segments.zh: 中国希望打造更先进的制造能力，而机械手正是这一计划的重要部分。

segments.en: And it's all to be made a massive start.
segments.zh: 这一切都将大规模启动。

segments.en: By some estimates, Chinese companies accounted for 97% of global humanoid shipments in the first half of 2026.
segments.zh: 据一些估算，2026年上半年，中国企业占全球人形机器人出货量的97%。

segments.en: This whole humanoid robot industry and really China dominates.
segments.zh: 整个人形机器人产业，确实由中国主导。

segments.en: These very dexterous robotic hands, which is one of the kind of bottlenecks in this industry, one of the hardest things to do for a robot is to manipulate its hand.
segments.zh: 这些非常灵巧的机械手，是该行业的瓶颈之一，机器人最难的事情之一就是操控手部。

segments.en: And if you can get that right, then you're one step closer to actually deploying humanoids like humans.
segments.zh: 如果能做到这一点，就离真正像人一样部署人形机器人更近一步。

segments.en: But is the technology actually within reach?
segments.zh: 但这项技术真的触手可及吗？

segments.en: The human hand is a miracle of anatomy.
segments.zh: 人手是解剖学上的奇迹。

segments.en: It can move in coordinated manner.
It can grasp with different amounts of pressure.
segments.zh: 它能以不同的压力抓握。

segments.en: It's really, really difficult to get a machine to do that.
segments.zh: 让机器做到这一点真的非常非常难。
